templates.above: {prefix}, burning in {region} is {pct}% above the typical {month_name}, higher than {k} of {n} past years.
templates.much_above: {prefix}, burning in {region} is {pct}% above the typical {month_name}, higher than {k} of {n} past years, among the highest on record.
templates.near: {prefix}, burning in {region} is close to the typical {month_name} ({signed_pct}%), higher than {k} of {n} past years.
templates.below: {prefix}, burning in {region} is {pct}% below the typical {month_name}, higher than only {k} of {n} past years.
templates.much_below: {prefix}, burning in {region} is {pct}% below the typical {month_name}, higher than only {k} of {n} past years, among the lowest on record.
templates.no_typical: {prefix}, burning in {region} cannot be compared with a typical {month_name}, because past years show almost none.
templates.no_data: There is not enough data yet to describe burning in {region} this {month_name}.
templates.basis_measured: Based on VIIRS measurements; the latest days are provisional.
templates.basis_estimated: Estimated from MODIS detections converted to VIIRS scale; treat it as an estimate with a range.
templates.basis_indicative: Indicative only: estimated from Terra alone, the least certain part of the record.
templates.near_saturation: On the busiest days more than half the tiles were burning, so the index flattens at the peak; read it with the fraction burning and the raw hotspot view.
templates.period: From {start} to {end}, burning in {region} stayed above the usual range for those dates for {days} days{severity} ({status}).
templates.local_normal_none: Not enough data this week to compare each sensor with its own normal.
templates.flag_both_elevated: both sensors are above their own normal
templates.flag_viirs_only: only VIIRS is above its own normal
templates.flag_modis_only: only MODIS is above its own normal
templates.flag_neither: neither sensor is above its own normal
templates.range_note: Range of yearly ratios, widened by tested error; not a confidence interval.
templates.index_note: Relative burning activity at VIIRS scale. It is not fire size, burned area or total fires.
templates.safety_disclaimer: Not an official fire alert, perimeter map or emergency tool.

local_normal_explanations.both_elevated: A genuine surge is more likely; two sensors agree.
local_normal_explanations.viirs_only: Many small or cool fires that only the sharper sensor sees, such as crop burning.
local_normal_explanations.modis_only: Timing, viewing, smoke or cloud effects; Indicative after 2019 (possible Terra/Aqua drift).
local_normal_explanations.neither: Normal background, or missing data (check coverage).
